modalities.evidence: intracranial electrophysiology recordings from macaque VPL thalamus

output.population: Macaques (Macaca fascicularis and Macaca mulatta), subject identifiers anonymized; source metadata instead lists 2 human participants aged 15–19
output.summary: Intracranial electrophysiology from macaque VPL thalamus recorded with a single-shank probe during focused ultrasound neuromodulation targeted at VPL or insular cortex, and during contralateral hand tactile stimulation.
